description:
Create a 'Clearance' section for the store. 

1. Add a new boolean field labeled 'Clearance Item' (machine name: field_clearance) to the Default Product type.
2. Edit the 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones' and 'Logitech MX Master 3S' products to set this new Clearance Item flag to True/On.
3. Create a new View page at path '/clearance' that lists ONLY products where 'Clearance Item' is True. Add a menu link labeled 'Clearance' to the Main navigation for this page.

Ensure the /clearance page works and shows only the flagged items.
